messages:
maria: Noticed a goroutine leak in our Go generator example when canceling a stream while auth refresh/backoff is in-flight. Minimal repro below — pretty small and reproducible with a slow auth proxy.

jon: Please paste the repro. I can run it on my laptop. :macbook:

maria: repro snippet from examples/go/generator_stream.go (trimmed):
```go
func RunStream(ctx context.Context, c *redwood.Client) error {
    it := c.Generator().Stream(ctx, &redwood.GenParams{Prompt: "hello"})
    defer it.Close()

    for it.Next() {
        _ = it.Token()
        if ctx.Err() != nil {
            break
        }
    }
    return nil
}
```

tara: Are calls to Close() blocking until the network pump exits? If so, and the pump is stuck on auth retry/backoff then Close() may hang and goroutines pile up after ctx.Cancel().

maria: Yep. Observed ~20 stuck goroutines in generator.streamIterator.readLoop() after cancelling the parent ctx, when the auth endpoint responded slowly during refresh.

jon: Two directions: (A) make Close accept a context (Close(ctx)) so the caller can bound how long they wait, or (B) add an Abort() that force-closes internal channels and returns immediately. Close(ctx) seems more idiomatic for Go.

tara: Close(ctx) is my preference. We can keep the old Close() as a shim: Close() -> Close(context.Background()). That keeps backward compat. Also need to ensure the internal read loop selects on internal cancel channel as well as network reads.

maria: I'll prototype CloseWithContext (name bikeshedding welcome) + unit test that simulates a slow auth refresh (fake HTTP client). Test should assert no goroutine leak after cancel + CloseWithContext with timeout.

jon: Also audit auth retry backoff to ensure it respects the iterator's internal cancel channel instead of only depending on network timeouts. Otherwise callers will still see delays.

tara: Agreed. For rollout, small patch + test, target v0.12.1. Add a short note in examples/go/README and update CHANGELOG under "generator: add Close(context) to allow bounded shutdown".

maria: Opening PR: github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/compare/maria/close-ctx-gen (wip). Assigning to jon for review.
